```plato
// An outlier test. Each statistic carries its threshold in its own native
// scale: standard deviations for ZScore
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_score), interquartile-range
// multiples beyond the quartiles for Iqr, and median-absolute-deviation
// multiples for Mad (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Median_absolute_deviation).
type OutlierDetection
    = ZScore(Threshold: Number)
    | Iqr(Threshold: Number)
    | Mad(Threshold: Number);
```
